title: Kagamine Len — Original Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Program Studio

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Welcome back to another episode of “Get on Those Hot Topics!”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We have a wonderful guest visiting us today, so let's get him on stage right away!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
Today's guest is...
Kagamine Len, the VIRTUAL SINGER!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Heya! I'm Kagamine Len!
Great to be here!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
Thank you for the energetic greeting!
I felt energized just watching you.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Now then, as I'm sure you all know, Len is a well-known VIRTUAL SINGER.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: By the way, you have your hair tied up in the back. So it's easier to move around, perhaps?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yup!
Wait, no, I should say it's for fashion. Umm... I look cooler this way, don't you think?>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's hope they make that part a bit smoother when they do the editing.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Now, one thing you can't forget when talking about Len is, of course, Kagamine Rin.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: You share the name “Kagamine”, but what exactly is your relationship?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe. I think I'll leave that up to each of you to decide! Ah, but I'd say a lot of songs have us as siblings.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Offering creators the freedom to tell the stories they see fit is yet another appeal of the VIRTUAL SINGERS!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Len here will be participating in the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show that's going to be held in Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I'm working with Rin and the others to get ready and make this a fun show, so look forward to it!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: As it turns out, we've received lots of messages from people who say they cannot wait for the show!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
This one's from a homemaker with a child:
“This will be the first time we take our child to a concert. Until the day arrives, we'll be having fun trying to each come up with the set list we think you'll go with.”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Surely they're all getting fired up making their predictions.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! It's great how they can get enjoyment not just from the day of the show, but in this lead-up time too!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Plus, I bet it'll be really exciting for them if any of their predictions come true!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Indeed. Any of you who'll be attending the show, why not give this a try with your friends and loved ones?

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: On the topic of the show, it seems that tickets have already sold out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Thanks to everybody who bought tickets! I'm looking forward to seeing you!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <And everybody who wasn't able to, don't worry. We actually have livestream and remote screening options too.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: That means you'll be able to watch the show from your neighborhood movie theater or even the comfort of your own home!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Right! So to everybody who was fretting about not being able to make it to Shibuya, don't you worry.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: It's nice that there are so many ways to take part. We even got this response in a street interview.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Good afternoon! You seemed quite invested in taking photos of this Rin and Len poster for the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Yes. My daughter and her friend both love them.

rows.Speaker: Daughter
rows.Line:
But, he's in a hospital in another country.
So, I'm taking pictures of the poster to send to him.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: So that's why you were taking so many pictures. I hope your friend likes them.

rows.Speaker: Daughter
rows.Line: Me too! And for their next show, we're going to watch the stream together on a video chat!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: It seems that, despite being hospitalized abroad, the friend of the girl I spoke to will be able to watch one of your livestreams with her.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Using such communication tools, we can enjoy chatting with friends as if they're right by our sides.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe. I've gotta do my best to make sure she and her friend both have lots of fun!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Well unfortunately, that's about all the time we have.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
Thank you for joining us today, Len.
We're all looking forward to your show.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Great! I'm gonna do my best to make this show enjoyable for everyone, whether you're at the venue, attending a screening or watching the stream!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay, everybody! I'll see you at the show!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Len, thank you very much for today!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: And with that...

rows.Speaker: Len & Host
rows.Line:
<Bye bye!>
Goodbye!
